newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore Corp Ltd to acquire Phoenix Group.
newsitem.headline: Moore Corp Ltd to acquire Phoenix Group.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd said on Thursday that it agreed in principle to acquire privately held Phoenix Group.
Moore Corp did not disclose any financial details of the transaction, but said Phoenix's direct marketing services in the automotive industry will complement Moore's customer communication services.

"The acquisition of Phoenix Group is consistent with our strategy of providing integrated data-based marketing services in a select vertical market," said Thomas McKiernan, president of Moore's customer communications services division.
